verseOne.line: I think they're starting to notice
The way they look and look away
We're getting nauseous as we sway with our bodies on display

pre-Chorus.line: I say a prayer, and it's in vain
I could spare you, I could change
You're a dog, and I'm the same

chorus.line: You ripped my dress, I dropped my glass
You didn't notice, and you stepped where it was wet
The mess below us pulled us in and ripped your skin
You said it's painless, and you grinned
It's hard to tango with a limp
